run_get_cluster_assignments: run the python module to extract video and audio cluster assignments from a trained multimodal model
parse_args_cli: parse command-line arguments for configuring dataset, model architecture, and distributed training parameters
compute_accuracy_topk: compute precision@k accuracy scores for model predictions against ground truth labels
sample_subset_indices: create a sampler that iterates over a subset of dataset indices for distributed data loading
load_model_multimodal: load a pretrained or randomly initialized multimodal video-audio model with configurable architecture and heads
